LLM-Review +1 received on change 1407.

Patch set 4. Patch set 3 cleared every drift gate, so the suite finally RAN - and produced exactly one failure, identically on all three ubuntu tiers:

  FAILED tests/unit/test_prompt_front_matter.py::test_built_in_prompt_round_trips_canonically[ticket-quality]
  AssertionError: ticket-quality: packaged prompt is not in canonical form

Cause: a fourth generated-artifact rule, one level deeper than the index.json lesson. Fixing the prompt-index gate meant editing the ticket_quality.md front-matter - but a packaged prompt file must itself be a FIXED POINT of the front-matter writer: write(*split_raw(file)) == file. My hand-edit was valid YAML with correct content but wrapped its lines differently than write_front_matter() emits, so the round-trip assertion failed on whitespace alone.

Fixed by running the file through the writer rather than hand-wrapping it:
  meta, body = _split_front_matter_raw(text); path.write_text(write_front_matter(meta, body))
Content is unchanged; only the YAML line wrapping moved. tests/unit/test_prompt_front_matter.py now 98 passed, and re-running regenerate-index leaves index.json byte-identical, so both gates hold together.

Extracted CI failures without waiting for the run to finish (gh run view refuses mid-run) via:
  gh api repos/navapbc/rebar/actions/jobs/<job-id>/logs --allow-escape-sequences
Worth knowing: per-job logs ARE readable while the run is still in progress; only the run-level log is gated.

Running tally of surfaces this ticket touched that are GENERATED rather than hand-authored, none of which the plan flagged: reviewers/index.json (derived from front-matter), ticket_quality.md front-matter (must be a writer fixed point), docs/cli-reference.md (from scripts/gen_cli_reference.py), docs/mcp-reference.md (from tool docstrings).
